description: This file contains Python code for integrating with the 'lunary' logging and tracking library within a larger software project. It includes functions for parsing usage data, tool call data, and message data, as well as a 'LunaryLogger' class that manages event logging, handling version checks, and error reporting.

classes.name: LunaryLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging events to the 'lunary' service, including version validation, event tracking, and error handling.

methods.name: parse_usage(usage)

methods.name: parse_tool_calls(tool_calls)
methods.description: Serializes tool call objects for logging.

methods.name: parse_messages(input)
methods.description: Cleans and serializes message inputs, including nested tool calls and message content.

methods.description: Initializes the logger, importing 'lunary' and checking its version.

methods.description: Logs an event to 'lunary', capturing details like start/end times, response output, errors, and metadata.
